notes: Camp Doha is where it really was: the Doha peninsula on Kuwait Bay, about 17 km west of Kuwait City (29.37 N, 47.80 E). Saved campaigns move it, and the units parked there, automatically

Camp Doha is now a major installation from the start, with every facility at its top level, and it finally appears in the 3D view: a 60×60 grid (about 1.1 km across) with rows of warehouses for the prepositioned brigade set, the ARCENT headquarters, trailer parks, two full-service DFACs, gym, PX, clinic, motor pools, a hangar, fuel farms, helipads and a Patriot battery inside a double wall
Two new structures for big installations: Warehouse and Headquarters
Brigade support areas are now small (24×24) instead of camp-sized
